newsitem.title: JAPAN: Furukawa Electric leaps on healthy earnings.
newsitem.headline: Furukawa Electric leaps on healthy earnings.

text.p: Furukawa Electric Co Ltd shares leapt on Tuesday morning, inspired by healthy earnings which were announced the previous day, brokers said.
As of 0053 GMT, the shares were up 34 yen or 5.53 percent at 649. It was the eighth largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
On Monday, the major electric wire and cable maker said that its parent current profit in the year to March 31, 1997, was 8.06 billion yen compared to 4.89 billion yen the previous year.
